seasonality.caption: Seasonality scorecard
seasonality.summary: Chosen window honors fixed dates; Alps nature priority with dawn/AC protocols offset Kansai heat and crowd risk.

validations.text: Single-country hub sequence: Tokyo → Japanese Alps (Takayama base) → Kyoto → Osaka → depart KIX
Open-jaw flights: NRT or HND in, KIX out — no backtracking to Tokyo for departure
Budget requires strategic splurges, not 14 days of luxury lodging
Nature interest elevates Alps allocation to at least 2 nights
Crowd aversion elevates timing discipline over attraction count

intro: - Style: Adventurous planner — structured days with room to wander; “optimized experience” (efficient moves, not rushed) - Pace: Moderate; one anchor activity per day; avoid intense athletic blocks - Authenticity: Prefer local gems over tourist traps; food tours and cultural experiences welcome - Ideal day: Good weather, great food, beautiful scenery, unhurried exploration

tables.caption: Core Identifiers
rows: Late July – early August 2026 (~14 days; itinerary anchor Jul 24 – Aug 6)

tables.caption: Budget
rows: $5,000 USD (all-in: flights, lodging, food, activities, local transport, buffer)
Spread across hubs—not concentrated in one city
~$357/day average; plan ~$1,000–1,400 for intl flights open-jaw, ~$3,600–4,000 on ground
One kaiseki or omakase slot, one Alps ryokan/onsen night, one paid nature experience (Kamikochi day or guided hike)

tables.caption: Deal-Breakers
rows: Early starts; weekday temples; skip peak-hour Shibuya photo ops; book timed entries; use Takayama/Kamikochi as relief; avoid scheduling Kyoto’s Gion at sunset on a Saturday in peak season

bullets.heading: Style & Pace
items: Style: Adventurous planner — structured days with room to wander; “optimized experience” (efficient moves, not rushed)
Pace: Moderate; one anchor activity per day; avoid intense athletic blocks
Authenticity: Prefer local gems over tourist traps; food tours and cultural experiences welcome
Ideal day: Good weather, great food, beautiful scenery, unhurried exploration

bullets.heading: Physical Profile
items: High fitness; comfortable walking several miles daily
Enjoys hiking but not extreme mountaineering

bullets.heading: Transit Experience & Preferences
items: Limited multi-country experience — favor clear hub changes, reserved seats, and app-based transit (Google Maps + Japan Transit Planner; Suica/PASMO)
Long drives acceptable if scenery rewards (Alps approach qualifies)

bullets.heading: Seasonal Constraints (late Jul – early Aug)
items: Heat/humidity in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka — outdoor blocks before 10:00 or after 16:00; midday indoor/AC
Rain — afternoon thunderstorms possible; daily rainy backup required (Step 04)
Pre-Obon travel — domestic volume rises late July; full Obon (typically mid-Aug) is mostly after this window but still plan for busy Shinkansen Sundays
